about_the_game:
A Game of European Values

In VAL-YOU, you're put in charge of a modern nation. Your mission is to keep things stable by balancing the needs of four areas: Politics, Society, Science, and the Economy.

The entire game is played with cards on a board. Each quarter, you'll see new challenges appear.

Features

  • A simple card-based system: Draw action cards and drag them onto problems or opportunities to resolve them.

  • Balance four pillars: Juggle the competing needs of Politics, Society, Science, and Economy.

  • See the consequences: Watch how your solutions create new, interesting challenges.

  • Establish core Values: Make choices that become permanent rules and give your nation a unique identity.

  • A living simulation: The board is always changing, forcing you to adapt your strategy.

  • Inspired by European democracy: Explores themes of social responsibility, economic policy, and political trade-offs in an interactive way.

Is VAL-YOU For You?

If you enjoy simple card-based resource management, mechanics with meaning behind them, you'll find a lot to love. VAL-YOU is designed for players who like to think, experiment, and watch the effects of their assumptions unfold.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • Processor: Dual Core 2 GhZ
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: DirectX9 compatible with at least 500MB of memory
  • DirectX: Version 9.0
  • Storage: 1 GB available space

short_description: Build a healthy democracy and shape the future of Europe in this Free Card Game. Play Cards as actions to balance the demands of Politics, Economy, Science, and Society in different political scenarios.
supported_languages: English, Italian, German, Spanish - Spain, Dutch, Greek
